headline: GitHub Copilot canvases let users describe a workflow surface in plain English and have an agent build it.
chosen_output_reason: This output cleanly depicts the four required conceptual stages with abstract canvas surfaces and no visible unsupported GitHub product controls.

alternate_output.rejection_reason: The alternate output adds avatar/chat-like interface elements that are more specific than the generic canvas abstractions permitted by the contract.

failure_reason: The accepted visual was materialized and hashed exactly, but the available GitHub connector mutations accept UTF-8 text or explicit blob content and provide no direct container-file/file-id binary handoff. Exact bytes therefore could not be persisted to the Q10 branch without re-encoding through an unsupported transport path. The matcher did not alter or substitute the image.
